Hard to say since you're so early. Lategame you want good variety since you need at least 4 teams plus supports for a whale support team to full clear DTide. GHelot, Corpo, and Pollux are all very good characters. They also all want e3. Do you have any particular gameplay styles you usually like in card games? Corpo is discard support and can be a DPS herself with the right supports, she's also Saya friendly. GHelot is a glass cannony DPS that wants to hold her big damage cards in hand to reduce their cost then play them out on a burst turn which also heals the team (she also wants very specific teammates that you don't have yet though). Pollux is a more standard DPS, you play his cards and they deal damage, his loop is obviously more complex than that but that's how he feels when I take him as a support, lol
